mapper.select: SELECT * FROM clients ORDER BY client_kana ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{num}
mapper.insert: insert into clients (client_name, client_kana, client_postalcode, client_address, client_phone) values (#{clientName}, #{clientKana}, #{clientPostalcode}, #{clientAddress}, #{clientPhone})
mapper.update: update clients set client_name = #{clientName}, client_kana = #{clientKana}, client_postalcode = #{clientPostalcode}, client_address = #{clientAddress}, client_phone = #{clientPhone} where client_id = #{clientId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM clients c JOIN projects p ON c.client_id = p.client_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId}
